description: Print the last 10 lines of each FILE to standard output.

option.name: --bytes
tip: output the last NUM bytes; or use -c +NUM to output starting with byte NUM of each file

option.name: --follow
tip: output appended data as the file grows; an absent option argument means 'descriptor'

option.name: --lines
tip: output the last NUM lines, instead of the last 10; or use -n +NUM to skip NUM-1 lines at the start

option.name: --max-unchanged-stats
tip: with --follow=name, reopen a FILE which has not changed size after N (default 5) iterations to see if it has been unlinked or renamed (this is the usual case of rotated log files); with inotify, this option is rarely useful

option.name: --pid
tip: with -f, terminate after process ID, PID dies; can be repeated to watch multiple processes

option.name: --retry
tip: keep trying to open a file if it is inaccessible

option.name: --silent
tip: never output headers giving file names

option.name: --sleep-interval
tip: with -f, sleep for approximately N seconds (default 1.0) between iterations; with inotify and --pid=P, check process P at least once every N seconds

option.name: --verbose
tip: always output headers giving file names

option.name: --zero-terminated
tip: line delimiter is NUL, not newline
